_comment: Tests Northern Physio's mandatory billing question for standard physio, Pelvic Floor qualifier before location gate, and service-location mismatch block for Exercise Physiology at Plenty Road.

scenarios.name: Standard physio — must ask private or insurance before routing

history.content: I'd like to book a physiotherapy appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Are you making a private booking, or claiming through an insurance or health fund provider?' as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent asks location first, routes to confirm_service, or asks new/existing before the billing question.

scenarios.name: Pelvic floor — must ask initial or follow-up before location

history.content: I need to book a pelvic floor appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Is this an initial consultation or a follow-up?' as a spoken-only turn before asking any location question. FAIL if agent asks location before the qualifier, routes directly to confirm_service, or asks the billing question.

scenarios.name: Exercise Physiology at Plenty Road — mismatch block fires

history.content: I'd like to book an exercise physiology appointment.
Which location would you like to come to? We have South Morang, or two locations in Epping -- Group One Medical on Edgars Road, or O'Herns Road Medical Centre on Manor House Drive.
South Morang please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the mismatch response ('That service isn't available at Plenty Road. It is available at our O'Herns Road location in Epping...') and offers the alternative location. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service with Plenty Road as the business location for Exercise Physiology.

scenarios.name: Max Health — direct signal bypasses billing question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book through Max Health Injury Management.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent skips the billing question and instead asks which location (LOCATION_QUESTION) as a spoken-only turn, without calling universal_router this turn. FAIL if agent asks the billing question, routes to confirm_service without asking location first, or does not recognise Max Health as an insurer scheme.

scenarios.name: Max Health — named via insurer question response, then location asked

history.content: I need a physio appointment.
Are you making a private booking, or claiming through an insurance or health fund provider?
Through Max Health.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the LOCATION_QUESTION as a spoken-only turn (no confirm_service call this turn). FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without first asking location, or asks the billing question again, or fails to recognise Max Health as an insurer scheme.

scenarios.name: Practitioner-only path — Physiotherapy answer must go through billing question, not straight to private

history.content: Can I book with Priya?
Are you after Physiotherapy or Exercise Physiology?
Physiotherapy.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Are you making a private booking, or claiming through an insurance or health fund provider?' as a spoken-only turn (no tool call). FAIL if agent calls confirm_service directly with appointment_type_id 1429516429945742473 / variant_type 'private', or asks the location question before the billing question.

scenarios.name: Practitioner-only path — Exercise Physiology answer skips billing question (no variant to distinguish)

history.content: Can I book with Priya?
Are you after Physiotherapy or Exercise Physiology?
Exercise Physiology.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent runs LOCATION GATE and asks the LOCATION_QUESTION as a spoken-only turn (confirmed_location not yet set), without asking any billing question. FAIL if agent asks a billing question, or calls confirm_service before location is resolved.

scenarios.name: REENTRY-INFO-PIVOT-LOC-1 INFO PIVOT RETURN GUARD — confirmed location is replayed in confirm_service

history.content: I'd like to book a physio appointment.
Are you making a private booking, or claiming through an insurance or health fund provider?
Private.
Which location would you like to come to? We have South Morang, or two locations in Epping -- Group One Medical on Edgars Road, or O'Herns Road Medical Centre on Manor House Drive.
The O'Herns Road one please.
One moment.

TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=confirm_service): {"uni_router_intent": "service_resolved", "appointment_type_id": "1429516429945742473", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Standard Appointment", "variant_type": "private"}
Sorry, one quick thing first — do you have parking?
Just a sec.
TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=info_pivot): {"uni_router_intent": "info_pivot"}
Our team can confirm parking details on the day. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all — let's go ahead and book.
TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=info_answered): {"info_answered": "true", "uni_router_intent": "info_answered"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent speaks exactly one filler phrase and in the SAME turn calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with a payload containing appointment_type_id='1429516429945742473', appointment_type='Physiotherapy Standard Appointment', variant_type='private', business_name="O'Herns Rd Medical Centre" (the canonical name from LOCATION RESOLUTION, not the caller's phrasing), business_id='1429516430365172840', and info_pivot_source='node_8'. FAIL if business_name/business_id are empty or omitted (the caller already chose a location earlier in this call), are emitted as literal placeholder text (e.g. '<confirmed_location>', '{{confirmed_location}}', 'confirmed_location'), or if the agent asks the LOCATION_QUESTION again.

scenarios.name: REENTRY-INFO-PIVOT-LOC-2 INFO PIVOT RETURN GUARD — no location confirmed yet: no fabricated or literal location fields

history.content: Hi, I'd like to rebook the same kind of appointment I had last time.
Just a sec.

TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=details_past): {"had_appointments": true, "appointment_type_id": "1429516429945742473", "appointment_type": "Physiotherapy Standard Appointment", "variant_type": "private"}
Sorry, one quick thing first — do you have parking?
Just a sec.
TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=info_pivot): {"uni_router_intent": "info_pivot"}
Our team can confirm parking details on the day. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all — let's go ahead and book.
TOOL RESULT (universal_router intent=info_answered): {"info_answered": "true", "uni_router_intent": "info_answered"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent EITHER (a) asks the LOCATION_QUESTION as a spoken-only turn with no tool call (no location has been confirmed yet, so LOCATION GATE applies), OR (b) calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1429516429945742473' and info_pivot_source='node_8' while OMITTING business_name and business_id entirely. FAIL if business_name/business_id appear with empty strings, with literal placeholder text (e.g. '<confirmed_location>', '{{confirmed_location}}', 'confirmed_location', 'none'), or with a location the caller never named.
